title: Deterministic Temporal Reconciliation for Effective-Dated Identity Lifecycle Events
abstract: arXiv:2609.14017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Identity lifecycle automation processes workforce changes that carry two distinct notions of time: when a business fact becomes effective and when an authoritative source last revised it. Corrections, cancellations, future-dated changes, duplicate delivery, and out-of-order arrival can therefore produce divergent account states when processors rely on transport order or effective time alone. This paper presents a deterministic temporal reconciliation method for effective-dated identity events. The method separates logical business facts from their physical revisions, deduplicates exact replays, selects the authoritative revision of each fact using transaction-time freshness, removes canceled facts, and then applies surviving facts in valid-time order. We establish permutation invariance, replay idempotence, revision dominance, and deterministic snapshot construction under explicit source assumptions. A reproducible synthetic fault-inject

translated_title: 面向生效日期身份生命周期事件的确定性时序调和
translated_abstract: 身份生命周期自动化所处理的人员变动包含两种不同的时间概念：业务事实何时生效，以及权威来源最后一次修订该事实的时间。因此，当处理逻辑仅依赖传输顺序或生效时间时，更正、取消、未来日期的变更、重复投递以及乱序到达都可能产生相互矛盾的账户状态。本文提出了一种针对生效日期身份事件的确定性时序调和方法。该方法将逻辑业务事实与其物理修订分离，对精确重放进行去重，基于事务时间新鲜度为每个事实选择权威修订，移除已取消的事实，随后按有效时间顺序应用留存的事实。在明确的源假设下，我们证明了置换不变性、重放幂等性、修订支配性以及确定性快照构建等性质，并提供了可复现的合成故障注入实验（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种确定性时序调和方法，通过区分业务生效时间与修订时间、分离逻辑事实与物理修订、去重重放并按有效时间顺序应用事实，解决了更正、取消、重复投递和乱序到达所导致的身份账户状态不一致问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deterministic temporal reconciliation method that separates logical business facts from physical revisions, deduplicates replays, and applies surviving facts in valid-time order, resolving divergent account states caused by corrections, cancellations, duplicates, and out-of-order identity lifecycle events.
